comment: Enables the Zero Subtotal Checkout method for orders whose total is zero.
modal: When **Yes**, the Zero Subtotal Checkout payment method is offered for orders that come to zero (for example fully covered by a discount or store credit). Can differ per website.

comment: The order status assigned to new zero-total orders placed with this method.
modal: The status given to a newly placed Zero Subtotal Checkout order — a status in the **New** or **Processing** state. Can differ per website.

comment: The position of this payment method relative to others at checkout.
modal: A numeric sort order that controls where Zero Subtotal Checkout appears in the list of payment methods. Can differ per website.

comment: The name shown to customers for this payment method at checkout.
modal: The label displayed for the Zero Subtotal Checkout method during checkout. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether this method is offered in all allowed countries or only specific ones.
modal: Chooses between **All Allowed Countries** and **Specific Countries** for where Zero Subtotal Checkout is available; the latter uses the Payment from Specific Countries list. Can differ per website.

comment: The countries where this method is offered when restricted to specific countries.
modal: The billing countries in which Zero Subtotal Checkout is available when **Payment from Applicable Countries** is set to Specific Countries. Can differ per website.
